text: After this, all you need to do is taste the\nsweets...
Well, at least there's a perk to this job!\nLet's get it done quickly so you can gimme my\nreward!
Okay...let's see if we can recreate what we\ncreated before...
Wow~...I'm impressed.\nMaking something like this using sweets...\nYou're actually quite talented, you know?
Hohohoho!!\nI'm flattered, but it's nothing special!
That's it, I guess...\nLet's turn them back to normal...
W-what the heck was that?!\nThose two are way more dangerous than me!\nWhy haven't they been arrested yet...?
All right, Lefina...\nIt's time to reveal our new creation...
Y-yeah, I know. Alright, here we go!
...?!\nIt wasn't supposed to look like this...!
W-whoaa!!\nW-why is it coming toward me?!
W-Why?! There was nothing wrong with my mixture.\nThis shouldn't be happening...
W-w-what?!\nAre you implying that this is my fault?
Well, I mean...\nGiven your past track record...
That's quite offensive!\nWell, I did substitute the cheap liquor with a\npremium one to improve the aroma, but that's it!
Just what I expected from you, Lefina.\nAlways go the extra mile...!
How can you still be happy after what she did?!
I think she didn't expect it to turn out this\nway...! I'll go make a neutralizer right away.\nPlease don't let this monster into the town...!
Ugh~! It's like this every single time!\nFine, whatever, go get it!!
Oh, thank you...!\nWe somehow managed to turn it back to normal.
B-but it was pretty strong, wasn't it?
Anyway, the sentries might come here after hearing\nall the noise we made.
Y-you're right!\nLet's just head back to town now!
